title: Permanent Resident
note: This page is for general reference only. Always check the latest requirements and documents on the Immigration Services Agency website: https://www.moj.go.jp/isa/.
tips:
- Continuous stay of 10+ years is required (shorter for spouses/children of Japanese nationals or Permanent Residents).

- With Highly Skilled Professional points system of 70+: eligible after 3+ years of stay.

- With Highly Skilled Professional points system of 80+: eligible after 1+ year of stay.
